payload.text: Carry::forward_factor(t) is a pure function computing the outright forward factor e^{b*t} via libm::exp(self.carry_rate() * t), where b is the net cost-of-carry (carry_rate() == r_dom - r_for for Carry::FxRates, == b for Carry::CostOfCarry). Multiplying spot by this factor yields the forward F = S*e^{b*t}; it has no side effects and depends only on (self, t). For FX this reproduces VanillaInputs::forward bit-for-bit, the single forward-construction primitive shared by every carry-seam leaf (ADR-0008).
